questions.question: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). A is the immediate neighbour of D and F. F is the immediate neighbour of E and A. B is in the second position from the right end. If D is not at any of the ends, then how many persons are sitting towards the left of D?
questions.solution:
Given: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F. 

1) B is in the second position from the right end.

2) A is the immediate neighbor of D and F. 

3) F is the immediate neighbor of E and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/356fea0245fa0a4b051aea703a532cad0cdc10b763d59001ecb0970ffb35c0fe.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f45f4f828d6a6483435acb3e464ce89555237e24637deb0f17074c0a18e2bda9.png] 

If D is not at any of the ends, then '**three**' persons are sitting towards the left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: Nine people Asha, Bishal, Carol, Dinky, Emily, Farah, Golu, Harsh, and Itika are watching a movie in a theatre sitting in a straight row facing North. Asha is on the immediate left of Farah. Farah is in the third place to the left of Bishal. Who are at the ends of the row?
questions.solution:
Given: Nine people Asha, Bishal, Carol, Dinky, Emily, Farah, Golu, Harsh, and Itika.

1) Bishal is at one end of the row. 

2) Farah is in the third place to the left of Bishal.

3) Asha is on the immediate left of Farah.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5154367e5938551ad526050f9408363aaffce35bf90062ed1ed045396cb582a1.png]

Here, 'Emily and Bishal' are at the ends of the row.

questions.question: In a festival sale, seven cars of different companies - A, B, C, D, E, F and G - are standing facing west. A is second to the left of B. B is third to the left of C. D is between F and B. C, which is fourth to the right of G, is at one end. Which of the following is the correct position of E?

options.text: Third to the left of B
Fourth to the left of A
Fifth to the right of G

questions.solution:
In a festival sale, seven cars of different companies - **A, B, C, D, E, F and G** - are standing facing west. 

1. C, which is fourth to the right of G, is at one end.

2. B is third to the left of C. 

3. D is between F and B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61d3c6d540cc3d38c9ab661a8399e9da6f7678e01e5223595a97ed29bdc06f79.png] 

4. A is second to the left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c9500939f26a2e74d1e1a1ea09a250df83372f4019824b057cf314ab6952131.png] 

5. E, the only car left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f21629647db76fe67decebded1d92cab39bd6b6cb17f9d9f86eff58e4bc01509.png] 

 
• Third to the left of B → E is third to the left of B.
 
• Fourth to the left of A → There is no one fourth to the left of A.
 
• Second to right of C → There is no one second to right of C.
 
• Fifth to the right of G → There is no one fifth to the right of G.

Clearly, third to the left of B is the correct position of E.

Hence, '**Third to the left of B**' is the correct answer.
